scope: Typed producer and final effect composition; same registered task, no actual native account or model execution.
frozen_additive_controls: Untyped initialization/auth/model permit refuses before subprocess or native submission.
Typed exact attempt/worker/host/configuration/model/effort/purpose/deadline is mandatory; actual Root claim matches.
Actual credential-free production composition uses disposable policy-revision-1 ledgers, not permissive signature substitutes.
Assignment final user/turn frame commits under Root then current model guard. Tool file/command effects use the active invocation then model then Core.
Neutral initialization uses a separately registered fixed-purpose invocation and a sticky initialization-only guard; it cannot grant work or startup proof without actual observed startup.
Auth preserves exact argv and 15-second Claude/10-second Codex maximum, clamped by original persisted invocation deadline.

Protected foreground merge is independently configured and keeps its existing authority/lifecycle; absent independent registration refuses. Native model call completion cannot stand in for merge completion.
execution_rule: Own-reviewed finite local batch under standing user authorization; preserve every raw result, callback precondition and separate nested stop proof. No accounts/providers/models, original ledger, normal activation or protected file edits.
